about.title: A profile at the crossroads of data and AI
about.intro: Currently a Data Engineer at Groupe Harvest in Paris, on a work-study program as part of an RNCP Bac+5 "Digital Innovation Manager" degree. My work spans data engineering, machine learning engineering, data analytics and agentic AI.
about.intlText: Professional experience in the United Arab Emirates that shaped an ability to thrive in multicultural, high-expectation environments.
about.searchText: I'm looking for a Data Engineer or AI Engineer role, available from October 2026.

timeline.title: Data Analyst & BI (Permanent) — Honeywell, United Arab Emirates
timeline.description: Centralized multi-source data (relational databases, APIs, SAP) and built SQL/Python/VBA pipelines to deliver reliable reporting in an international environment.

timeline.title: BI & Data Visualization Intern — Harvett Conseils Risque et Finances
timeline.description: Integrated and prepared multi-source data with Alteryx and Python to power Power BI dashboards and deliver reliable KPIs to business teams.

timeline.title: Data Engineer & AI Engineer (Work-study) — Groupe Harvest
timeline.description: Designed and productionized a hybrid RAG agent (LangGraph, Qdrant, LLM-as-judge) and an XGBoost churn prediction model, as part of the RNCP Bac+5 "Digital Innovation Manager" degree.
